message:
ERROR: Cannot execute multiple commands at once.
Please run each command separately OR chain them into a single command via && or ;
Provided commands:
(1) cd /workspace/repo-vul/work-vul/build && mkdir -p /tmp/fribidi_build && cd /tmp/fribidi_build && \
SRC=/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/fribidi && \
BUILD=/workspace/repo-vul/work-vul/build && \
for f in $SRC/lib/*.c; do
  gcc -c -O1 -g -fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer \
    -I$SRC/lib -I$BUILD/lib -I$BUILD/gen.tab -I$SRC \
    -DHAVE_CONFIG_H -DFRIBIDI_ENTRY='__attribute__((visibility("default")))' \
    -o /tmp/fribidi_build/$(basename $f .c).o $f || echo "FAIL $f"
done
(2) echo "done compiling"; ls /tmp/fribidi_build/*.o | wc -l
